components.author: Springtale Maintainers
components.name: springtale-mlbom-generator
components.description: Hand-curated ML-BOM for the AI adapters Springtale ships. Maps to OWASP LLM03 (training data poisoning) and LLM10 (unbounded consumption / model supply-chain): every AI socket Springtale exposes is enumerated here with provenance, license, and quantisation.

component.name: Springtale
component.description: Local-first privacy-preserving automation platform. AI is per-bot, opt-in, and always defaultable to NoopAdapter.

components.name: NoopAdapter
components.description: Built-in no-op adapter. The default for every bot. Routes every AiRequest to AiError::Disabled — no network call, no model inference. Used to prove the platform works without any AI, and for adapters that have not yet been configured by the user.

useCases: fallback when no AI adapter is configured
regression-testing the platform under zero-AI conditions
deployment to environments where outbound AI calls are forbidden

components.name: Ollama
components.description: Adapter targeting a locally-hosted Ollama daemon. Model weights live on the user's machine; no data leaves the box. The adapter optionally pins the model's SHA-256 manifest digest (`OllamaConfig::expected_digest`) to defend against a poisoned local model store (OWASP LLM03).

modelParameters.modelArchitecture: varies — Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc. — selected by `OllamaConfig::model`

useCases: local-only chat with no third-party visibility
structured extraction with provider-side schema enforcement
tool-use / agent loops gated by the platform's capability bridge

ethicalConsiderations.name: model provenance
ethicalConsiderations.value: Variable. The deploying user picks the model. Springtale ships no model weights; the user is responsible for licence / origin / bias review.

ethicalConsiderations.name: data residency
ethicalConsiderations.value: All inference is local. No prompts or completions leave the host.

components.name: OpenAI-compatible
components.description: Adapter targeting OpenAI's chat-completions API and any compatible third-party endpoint (vLLM, llama.cpp server, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.). Outbound TLS via rustls (hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 KEX once Phase 5 #1 lands). Sanitiser layer removes credentials / PII / prompt-injection markers from every user-facing prompt BEFORE the request leaves the daemon.

useCases: cloud-hosted chat where local inference is impractical

ethicalConsiderations.name: data residency
ethicalConsiderations.value: Prompts and completions transit the provider's infrastructure. Bot configuration must surface this to the user (per the data_disclosure manifest field on every connector that feeds external content to AI).

ethicalConsiderations.name: vendor lock
ethicalConsiderations.value: Mitigated by the OpenAI-compatible base URL — any compliant endpoint works without code changes.

components.name: Anthropic
components.description: Adapter targeting Anthropic's Messages API. Native tool-use surface. Outbound TLS via rustls.

useCases: agent loops with the runtime's capability-checked tool execution

ethicalConsiderations.name: data residency
ethicalConsiderations.value: Prompts and completions transit Anthropic's infrastructure. Same disclosure surfacing rule as the OpenAI adapter.
